label: Health, medical or wellness
summary: No promises of universal cures or medical diagnosis guarantees
Explicit guidance to consult certified medical professionals
tone_principles: Empathetic, scientifically objective, cautious, and human-centered. Never imply autonomous diagnosis.
writing_style: Plain clinical English avoiding both alarmist medical jargon and unscientific hype.
messaging_principles: Always frame health tools as supportive resources under the guidance of licensed clinicians.
do_examples: Clinical decision support assists physicians by prioritizing diagnostic scans for review.
Always consult your qualified healthcare provider regarding symptoms or treatment plans.
dont_examples: Our miracle algorithm guarantees 100% cure rates and replaces doctors!
Diagnose your heart condition autonomously without seeing a physician.

rules.title: Prohibit Unverified Cure Claims & Diagnostic Guarantees
rules.description: Health and wellness content must never claim guaranteed medical cures or 100% diagnostic precision.

suggested_replacements.100% cure rate: high therapeutic response rate observed in clinical trials
suggested_replacements.100% diagnostic accuracy: high sensitivity in clinical validation studies

rules.do_example: Our software assists radiologists by highlighting potential anomalies for clinical inspection.
rules.dont_example: Our AI guarantees a 100% cure rate and replaces radiologists.

rules.title: Mandate Physician Consultation & Assistive Framing
rules.description: Do not state that medical software operates autonomously without practitioner supervision.

suggested_replacements.diagnose yourself without a doctor: monitor your wellness trends to share with your physician

rules.do_example: Share these symptom trends with your physician during your next consultation.
rules.dont_example: Use our tool to diagnose yourself without a doctor.

terminology.notes: Medical devices and software assist board-certified clinicians.
Medical products must avoid hyperbolic or unscientific claims.
